nodes.description: Immutable constant GRACE_PERIOD = 14 days, upper bound on how stale a queued transaction may be when executed.
Immutable constant MINIMUM_DELAY = 2 days, lower bound enforced on the timelock delay.
Immutable constant MAXIMUM_DELAY = 30 days, upper bound enforced on the timelock delay.
Address of the current timelock administrator; sole authorised caller of queue/cancel/execute.
Address nominated to become the next admin; must call acceptAdmin to take over.
Minimum delay in seconds between queuing and executing a transaction.
One-time bootstrap flag controlling whether setPendingAdmin is callable by admin or only by the contract itself.
Mapping txHash => bool recording which queued transactions are still executable.
Timelock constructor: validates the initial delay bounds and sets admin, delay and admin_initialized.
receive() external payable: allows the timelock to receive plain Ether transfers.
setDelay(uint): self-call only, updates the timelock delay within min/max bounds.
acceptAdmin(): pendingAdmin claims the admin role and clears pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin(address): nominates a new pending admin; first call must come from admin, later calls from the contract itself.
queueTransaction(...): admin-only, records txHash in queuedTransactions after verifying the eta satisfies the delay.
cancelTransaction(...): admin-only, clears the queued flag for the derived txHash.
executeTransaction(...): admin-only, validates queue/eta/grace period then performs an arbitrary external call with value.
getBlockTimestamp(): internal view returning block.timestamp.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): checked addition reverting on overflow.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default message.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256,string): checked subtraction reverting on underflow.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): checked multiplication reverting on overflow.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default message.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256,string): checked division reverting on division by zero.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256): delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default message.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256,string): checked modulo reverting on modulo by zero.
msg.sender: attacker-controllable caller address used for all authorisation checks.
block.timestamp: validator-influenceable time source driving the timelock delay and grace period.
Low-level call target.call.value(value)(callData) in executeTransaction: arbitrary external call transferring Ether, no reentrancy guard.
State write queuedTransactions[txHash] = false in executeTransaction, performed before the external call without any reentrancy mutex.
Arithmetic addition (eta.add(delay), eta.add(GRACE_PERIOD), timestamp.add(delay)) performed through SafeMath checked addition.
constructor parameter admin_ (initial admin address).
constructor parameter delay_ (initial timelock delay).
setDelay parameter delay_ (new timelock delay).
setPendingAdmin parameter pendingAdmin_ (nominee address).
queueTransaction parameter target (callee address to be executed later).
queueTransaction parameter value (wei to forward).
queueTransaction parameter signature (function selector string).
queueTransaction parameter data (calldata payload).
queueTransaction parameter eta (earliest execution timestamp).
Local txHash computed in queueTransaction from the encoded arguments.
cancelTransaction parameter target.
cancelTransaction parameter value.
cancelTransaction parameter signature.
cancelTransaction parameter data.
cancelTransaction parameter eta.
Local txHash computed in cancelTransaction from the encoded arguments.
executeTransaction parameter target, used as the external call destination.
executeTransaction parameter value, Ether amount forwarded to target.
executeTransaction parameter signature, encoded into callData.
executeTransaction parameter data, appended to the selector in callData.
executeTransaction parameter eta, lower time bound for execution.
Local txHash computed in executeTransaction and checked against queuedTransactions.
Local callData built in executeTransaction from signature and data.
Local success flag returned by the low-level external call.
Local returnData bytes returned by the low-level external call.

edges.reason: GRACE_PERIOD constant bounds the staleness check inside executeTransaction.
MINIMUM_DELAY is enforced on the constructor delay_ argument.
MINIMUM_DELAY is enforced on setDelay's delay_ argument.
MAXIMUM_DELAY is enforced on the constructor delay_ argument.
MAXIMUM_DELAY is enforced on setDelay's delay_ argument.
Constructor writes the initial admin state variable.
acceptAdmin overwrites admin with msg.sender.
setPendingAdmin compares msg.sender against admin on first initialisation.
queueTransaction authorises the caller against admin.
cancelTransaction authorises the caller against admin.
executeTransaction authorises the caller against admin.
acceptAdmin requires the caller to equal pendingAdmin and then clears it.
setPendingAdmin assigns the pendingAdmin state variable.
Constructor initialises the delay state variable.
setDelay writes the delay state variable.
queueTransaction reads delay when validating eta against the current timestamp.
Constructor explicitly initialises admin_initialized to false.
setPendingAdmin branches on and later sets admin_initialized.
queueTransaction writes true into queuedTransactions for the derived txHash.
cancelTransaction clears the queuedTransactions entry for the derived txHash.
executeTransaction reads and then clears the queuedTransactions entry.
setDelay is gated by require(msg.sender == address(this)), restricting who may change the delay.
acceptAdmin is gated by require(msg.sender == pendingAdmin), a caller-controlled authorisation check.
setPendingAdmin authorises msg.sender either as the contract itself or as admin depending on admin_initialized.
queueTransaction is gated by require(msg.sender == admin).
cancelTransaction is gated by require(msg.sender == admin).
executeTransaction is gated by require(msg.sender == admin) before any external call.
getBlockTimestamp returns block.timestamp directly, creating a timestamp dependency.
queueTransaction derives the eta lower bound from getBlockTimestamp().add(delay), making the guard miner-influenceable.
executeTransaction compares block.timestamp against eta and eta + GRACE_PERIOD.
queueTransaction calls SafeMath.add to compute the minimum eta.
Addition of the timelock delay to the current timestamp is the arithmetic operation performed in queueTransaction.
executeTransaction calls SafeMath.add to compute eta.add(GRACE_PERIOD).
Timestamp plus grace period addition is the arithmetic operation performed in executeTransaction.
SafeMath.add implements the checked addition vulnerable to overflow if unchecked.
2-argument SafeMath.sub delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default error message.
2-argument SafeMath.div delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default error message.
2-argument SafeMath.mod delegates to the 3-argument overload with a default error message.
executeTransaction performs an arbitrary low-level external call carrying value before returning.
The external call can re-enter executeTransaction (or other admin functions) since no reentrancy guard is present.
executeTransaction mutates queuedTransactions state before invoking the untrusted external call.
The pre-call state write clears queuedTransactions[txHash], a state change reachable during the external call window.
